message.content:
Flared trousers in a structured camel wool blend, mid-calf length, soft tan (hex: #C19A6B).
Relaxed-fit blouse with a subtle puff sleeve, elbow length, heather grey (hex: #80858E), brushed cotton.
Chunky leather ankle booties with a low block heel, chestnut brown (hex: #4E3B30).
A textured cable-knit cardigan worn loosely over the blouse for extra warmth against the autumn chill.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance between everyday comfort and neat sophistication suitable for a first date in the park. The earthy tones of camel and chestnut harmonize beautifully with the golden hues of fall foliage, while the layered textures of wool and knit add visual interest without appearing overdressed. The flared silhouette creates an elegant line that elevates simple separates into a polished look, allowing you to feel confident yet relaxed as you explore the outdoors together.
